1.explanation: All of the files listed implement or expose the FormGroup and RadioButtonGroup components and their tests. FormGroup.js renders the <fieldset> and <legend> but does not accept or apply a legendId prop, so must be updated to forward that ID to the legend and add an aria-labelledby on the fieldset. The index.js files export the component and propType definitions, so they must declare the new legendId prop. The corresponding test files verify component behavior and need to be updated to cover the new legendId API. Similarly, RadioButtonGroup.js currently does not allow custom legend attributes at all, so must be enhanced in parallel, and its index.js and test file updated accordingly.
1.bug_scenario: When a developer uses the Carbon React FormGroup or RadioButtonGroup components and passes a custom legendId (for example legendId="row-height-label"), the legend element never gets the id applied and the fieldset never gets its aria-labelledby attribute wired up correctly. In other words, although we can pass arbitrary props into the fieldset via FormGroup, there is no mechanism to pass an id into the legend. And RadioButtonGroup has no support at all for custom legend attributes. As a result, screen readers cannot associate the legend label with the fieldset, failing a11y requirements.

2.explanation: FormGroup.js defines the <fieldset> and its <legend> in the FormGroup component; it needs to accept and apply a legendId prop (pass it as the id on <legend>, and hook that id up with aria-labelledby on the fieldset). FormGroup-test.js must be updated to include a test for the new legendId behavior. Similarly, RadioButtonGroup.js renders its own <fieldset> and <legend> for the radio group; it must be extended to accept a legendId prop and forward it correctly, while still spreading extra props (e.g. aria-labelledby) onto the fieldset. RadioButtonGroup-test.js needs a new spec to validate that legendId is applied and that the fieldset’s aria-labelledby matches it.
2.bug_scenario: When you wrap a group of radio buttons (or checkboxes) in a FormGroup or RadioButtonGroup and supply your own legend id—for example legendId="row-height-label"—the id never makes it onto the <legend>, so although your fieldset gets aria-labelledby="row-height-label", it has nothing to point at. There is no API in FormGroup or RadioButtonGroup to pass a custom id through to the legend, and so screen-readers can’t associate the legend text with the fieldset.
